items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: They heard Prima played like Louis Armstrong. And I said, if they wanted the original, they'd get the Armstrong. Why get an imitator?

ctx.x: How long was Muggsy with you there too?

Uh, I got Muggsy with Lewis. He was with Lewis for about seven years. He was with, uh, Ray Miller's band down the, uh, Sherman. And I went to him and I says, uh, I told Lewis, I says, I got a good man down there, Sherman. He says, well, if you recommend him, he must be good. He says, I'll take him without hearing him. I says, oh, no. I says, you're going to hear him first. He says, I don't want me taking him. So Muggsy auditioned for him and he liked Muggsy. Muggsy stayed with him for seven years. And, uh, then…
